column5: Description

column4: Sea Greaves of the Veiled Heritance
column5: The Maormer raiders of Bewan used gear like this, all originally forged on their fog-choked home islands.

column4: Signs of magical craftsmanship are evident on this weighty belt.

column5: Forged at the height of Highlord Rilis the XII's reign, the sigil of that house is subtly worked into these shoulderplates.

column4: Dunmer daggers in this style purportedly contain secret compartments for poison, though no one has ever located any.

column5: Standard issue to the Dominion soldiers who guard Thalmor diplomats, these helms are crafted to be as comfortable as possible.
This hammer saw heavy use in the fight for Dawnbreak.

column4: Veiled Executioner of the Twin Sisters
column5: Taken from the Heritance in Del's Claim, this massive axe bears the maker's mark of Mathiisen.

column4: Symbols of the Veiled Heritance, bitter opponents to Queen Ayrenn's rule, are hidden on the gauntlets' inner lining.

column5: Found amidst the webbing in Entila's Folly, this sturdy staff is lightly etched with simple runes.
The runes etched into this simple loop are almost too small to see. The steadiest of hands enchanted this item.

column4: The base of this staff bears the personal mark of Telenger the Artificer. The smell of rain accompanies it everywhere.

column5: Something about this staff exudes a terrible chill that settles deep into the bones.
Faintly, as if from a far distance, you can hear the strained laughter of a delusional mind.

column4: Serpent-Rider Spaulders of the Twin Sisters
column5: Bearing the maker's mark of a Sea Elf leatherworker, this shoulder armor displays the scars of the fight for Greenwater Cove.

column4: Snapjaw's Tooth of the Veiled Heritance
column5: In truth, only the core of this blade is made up of clannfear tooth, but it's more than enough to give the sword a vile taint.

column4: Loyalist's Longbow of the Veiled Heritance
column5: The Veiled Heritance soldiers training on the shores of Auridon have imbued this longbow with icy, slow-flowing malice.
Initials on the handle hint at ports visited by this blade's former owner.
This carefully tooled leather chestpiece was made specially for the Eyes of the Queen, Ayrenn's hand-picked agents.

column4: Spitescarred Leggings of the Twin Sisters
column5: Taken from the Daedra at Mehrunes' Spite... it's better not to think about where the leather for these breeches came from.

column4: The runes sewn into this mantle would be sufficient to frighten any of the lower orders of Daedra.

column5: The legends of fire-breathing snakes are just that, legends. Or so they say.
The Eyes of the Queen use highly specialized gear. This belt, for example, has a small pouch secreted behind the buckle.

column4: This cloth was hand-dyed in the far-off land of Glenumbra, and issued to a loyal member of the Covenant armed forces.
Sea Serpent's Tooth of the Twin Sisters
column5: The Maormer at Ondil used several pieces of gear crafted from the skin and teeth of their sacred sea serpents.
This simple staff is stained from numerous alchemical substances.
These boots were fashioned from the hide of a kagouti, a creature from far-off Shadowfen.

column4: This exquisite weapon is only given for exceptional service to the Aldmeri Dominion.
Sea-Raider's Hood of the Twin Sisters
column5: Opportunistic bandits, such as the ones at Seaside, have taken the Three Banners War as a call to arms.
Sewn into the hem of this robe are numerous runes meant to ward and bind spirits and Daedra.
This utilitarian staff is like the ones used by the warmages of the First Auridon Marines.
Though carefully cleaned, an odor of death still permeates these gloves.

column4: This simple loop is worn from where it was repeatedly twisted around tired, grieving fingers.

column5: Smelling vaguely of embalming fluid and cremation ash, this hood was a dear treasure on Soulfire Plateau.
The fine etching on these leggings is typical of Maormer crafting techniques.
These simple slippers are worn by priests tending the ancient Aldmeri site of Tanzelwil.

column4: Queen Ayrenn herself has tuned and tightened the bowstring on this weapon, ensuring every arrow flies straight and true.

column5: Metalsmiths from across the Summerset Isles collaborated to forge this chestpiece, a token of esteem directly from the Queen.
Small sigils representing each of the Eight Divines, invisible to the naked eye, run along the inside face of this shield.

column4: Simple runes are sewn into the sash, revering the Eight Divines in their myriad forms.

column5: These greaves are well appointed, with gold accents and inlaid runes.

column4: A mysteriously collectible and sought-after piece, despite being worth next to nothing.

column5: The dead of Wansalen were tightly controlled, likely because of the numerous Daedric runes sewn at this kilt's hem.

column4: The Captain's Helm of the Veiled Heritance
column5: Once worn by Captain Blanchete himself, this helm has seen every shore in southern Tamriel.
